# README placement and links

You should put your README.md in the repository **root** so it shows up on the project's home page.
You can also keep documentation in a `docs` folder if you have a lot of it.

For a table of contents, you can add one manually near the top by writing a bulleted list of links to
your headings.

To link between sections, use the heading's **anchor**: a heading like `## Usage` can be linked to
with `[jump to usage](#usage)`. To link to another file such as CONTRIBUTING, add a Markdown link to
it, for example `[Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md)`.
